snippet.title: Soggy Beans | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Think birdwatching, but with fish. Soggy Beans is a calming and low intensity idle game designed to be played on the side of other things. This fresh(water) trailer features new backgrounds and decorating content, and a general update in polish to showcase these wet friends in their best light!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636430/Soggy_Beans/ 

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
